description:
The later prototype version of Super Mario Kart's Vanilla Lake.
Thanks to this Dropbox link of the recording from the game that Dave Harris/iridescentaudio (the person who transcribed a pretty accurate MIDI of it in 2008) kept, I was able to use that as a reference to help me port this!
